results.label: 17 install panels (13 real entries + 4 synthetic)
synthetic-hello: 'Kurulabilir'
synthetic-unverified-tool: 'Doğrulama tamamlanmadı' and no install button
synthetic-license-pending: 'Lisans incelemesi gerekli' and no install button
a REAL catalog entry (gitleaks) is 'Doğrulama tamamlanmadı' with no install button
a REAL entry cannot be previewed even through the IPC (forged call)
the manager's folder does not exist yet (looking created nothing)
open the installation preview
preview heading is shown
preview: exact version, platform, digest, file name
preview: every file-system effect listed, none absolute
preview: says nothing is executed, no network, PATH untouched
preview: notices (components + unresolved) are part of the confirmation
preview: says what the confirmation is NOT (no identity proof)
preview: marked SENTETİK DENEME
the confirm button is disabled until the acknowledgement is ticked
nothing was created by opening a preview
a second preview supersedes the first (the old one is gone)
forged confirm: unknown extra field (path) is rejected by the IPC layer
forged confirm: not acknowledged -> refused, nothing happens
forged confirm after that: the burned offer cannot be used any more
forged confirm: made-up offer id and malformed id are refused
still nothing created after the forged attempts
open a preview again and cancel it with 'Vazgeç'
after cancelling the tool is 'Kurulabilir' again
a cancelled offer cannot be confirmed (forged replay of the cancelled id)
nothing created by cancel
retained tool: 'Kurulabilir' (the fixture sits in the fixed input folder)
retained file missing: the preview is refused with its code and creates nothing
retained file with the right size but other content: refused (INSTALL_ARTIFACT_REJECTED)
nothing was created by those refusals
retained file back: preview opens; the file is swapped for other content BEFORE the confirmation
the swap was caught before the first change: no manager folder exists
install the retained tool through the real window
the retained tool is on disk, equals the retained file, and the retained file itself is unchanged
remove the retained tool; the retained file is still there byte-identical
open the preview and tick the acknowledgement
the confirm button is now enabled and is pressed
result: 'Tamamlandı' and the receipt is shown
the file is on disk exactly where the preview said, with the digest the preview showed
the version folder holds ONLY artifact.bin (no sidecar / notice file)
no file outside the manager folder and the database was created
the manager folder holds exactly the fixed layout
no lock, staging or snapshot leftovers
the installed file is NOT executed: it is a plain data file and nothing started
a second install of the same tool is refused before any preview exists
after the result the status is 'Kurulu ve doğrulandı'
open the installed-tool details
details: version, relative location, digest, 5 passed checks, notices, 'yapmadıkları'
details show no absolute path or account name
dashboard counts one installed tool
audit chain still verifies after the whole sequence
open the REMOVAL preview and confirm it
result: removal 'Tamamlandı'
the version folder and the pointer are gone
the tool's own user data is byte-identical
status is 'Kaldırıldı'
reinstall through the same preview and confirmation
reinstalled: 'Tamamlandı'
a tampered installed file is reported as 'Başarısız / dikkat gerekiyor' (drift)
nothing was repaired or deleted: the tampered bytes are still there
no removal/install can be opened for a drifted tool
once the owner restores the file the tool verifies again
removal with a failing audit write: the answer says it was DONE but the audit row is missing (needs attention)
the removal really happened on disk
the tool is 'Başarısız / dikkat gerekiyor' with the audit reason and no new operation can be opened
recovery while the audit trail still fails reconciles nothing and says so
recovery with a working audit trail rebuilds the missing row from the receipt and the journal
the tool is 'Kaldırıldı' again and recovery changed no file of the manager folder
the status is 'Kaldırıldı' after the reconciliation
a second recovery reconciles nothing more (idempotent)
installation with a failing pre-installation audit write is REFUSED (audit_unavailable) and changes no file
with the audit trail working again the installation goes through (a NEW preview and confirmation)
the audit chain verifies after all of that
